note: Length of tip: .143″. Recommended use: Small to Medium game Hunting. form factor= 1.05. The product page also says: "This Hammer HBC™ will run in 1-10″ or faster twist barrels, making it good for many of the factory rifles out there. With only two PRD drive bands this pure copper bullet has very low engraving pressure resulting if very high velocity potential. It will run well over 4000 fps in a 22-250 with a relatively high ballistic coefficient it is lethal to very long range."
